Start, raise and grow faster with SeedLegals.

product.name: Legal Document Automation Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that automates the creation, customization, sharing, signing, and storage of legal documents for startups and small businesses.

product.name: Funding Round Management
product.description: A service to facilitate startup fundraising by generating compliant legal documents, managing cap tables, and supporting SEIS/EIS tax relief compliance.

product.name: Share Option Schemes Management
product.description: A service to create and manage employee share option schemes, including EMI and unapproved schemes, with legal documentation and valuations.

product.name: R&D Tax Credits Service
product.description: A service to help startups and SMEs claim Research and Development tax credits by preparing and submitting claims with expert support.

product.name: General Counsel as a Service (GCaaS)
product.description: A subscription service providing startups with access to dedicated senior lawyers for on-demand legal advice on commercial contracts, employment law, IP strategy, and data privacy.

product.name: Cap Table and Shareholder Management
product.description: A digital tool to manage company equity, shareholders, share classes, share transfers, and related corporate governance documents.
